processing: Crop generated semantic cells, premultiplied-alpha area resize, periodic edge stitching, original topology masks, freshRGBA overlay art fit to original native ink bounds. No native per-pixel colour tint or source-colour embossing.
alphaCaveat: Overlays requested transparent but built-in raw returned semiopaque white matte (all alpha133..251); builder reconstructs cutout alpha using confidence226..244 and white-matte suppression, clearing<=8 and decontaminating partial edges. Raw remains unchanged.
fidelityLimits: Generated patterns intentionally differ from original pixels
Crater/debris/body/track/bloom states derive from six whole-object paintings using native extents/direction, not unique illustrations for each small original state
Masks preserve native class identities and approximate original borders; selective one-pixel morphological closure and boundary smoothing are visual changes
Fog masks remain exact source geometry at4x nearest; native simulation, input and collision are untouched
